objective: Test whether any single UEID-derived diagnostic adds out-of-sample crisis discrimination beyond the surviving volatility-plus-market-synchronization baseline, without relying on the failed full UEID-lite bundle.

outcome.label: forward 21 trading day maximum drawdown <= -8%
secondary_metrics: recall and precision under validation-calibrated 5% alert budget

candidate_additions.r_edge: spectral concentration of thresholded correlation network

falsification.bootstrap: moving-block bootstrap, block length 12 sampled feature rows, 1000 replicates
falsification.familywise_ci: 98.75% two-sided CI for candidate-minus-node AUC delta (Bonferroni alpha=0.05/4)
candidate_survival_rule: 98.75% bootstrap CI lower bound for AUC delta > 0
test AUC delta versus its matched null >= 0.01
candidate-minus-node AUC is positive in at least 2 of 3 frozen eras: 2015-2019, 2020-2022, 2023-latest
falsification.global_decision: SUPPORTED COMPONENT if one or more candidates meet all candidate survival rules; otherwise NO INCREMENTAL UEID COMPONENT SURVIVES
falsification.alert_rule: calibrate probability threshold on validation predictions to target top 5% alerts, then apply that fixed threshold to test predictions

constraints: No selecting a candidate on test performance and refitting
Full UEID model is reference-only and cannot rescue a failed component-wise decision
NESS remains excluded because the synthetic UEID v3.6 pilot failed its NESS gate
This experiment tests predictive increment, not proof of a physical market phase transition or trading profitability
